name: Bloomingdale's American Express® Card
balance_transfer_apr: 32.99%, for balance transfers completed within 4 months of account opening
balance_transfer_fee: The greater of $10 or 5% of the amount of each transfer
late_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another late payment occurs within 6 billing cycles
returned_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another returned payment occurs within 6 billing cycles

welcome_bonus.bonus: 20% off, up to $250 total, plus 20,000 points ($100 reward)
welcome_bonus.requirement: 20% off on purchases the day you open a Bloomingdale's card and the day after; the points need $1,000 in net purchases outside Bloomingdale's in the first 90 days

verdict.text: Unremarkable outside Bloomingdale's: a flat 2% card beats it elsewhere

earn_rates.category: Bloomingdale's, bloomingdales.com & The Outlet: Top of the List Unlocked ($15,000+ a year at Bloomingdale's)
Bloomingdale's, bloomingdales.com, The Outlet & everywhere Amex is accepted: Loyallist tier (default)
Bloomingdale's & everywhere Amex is accepted: Top of the List ($5,000+ a year at Bloomingdale's), and Top of the List Unlocked outside Bloomingdale's

earn_note: This is the open-loop American Express version of Bloomingdale's card: it earns outside Bloomingdale's, unlike the closed-loop, store-only Bloomingdale's Credit Card, which earns nothing anywhere else. At Bloomingdale's, both cards earn 3, 4 or 10 points per $1 at Loyallist, Top of the List and Top of the List Unlocked. Everywhere else, this card earns 3 points at Loyallist and 4 at either higher tier. Top of the List takes $5,000 and Unlocked $15,000 in net purchases in a calendar year, and only spend at Bloomingdale's, The Outlet, Bloomie's and bloomingdales.com counts.

redemption_options.method: Reward redeemable the day after earning, applied at Bloomingdale's or bloomingdales.com

points.per_100k: $500 in Bloomingdale's rewards (5,000 points = $25), though points can't be banked for long: 85% of any balance is forfeited every January 1
points.note: Despite the open-loop Amex network letting you earn everywhere, redemption is closed-loop: rewards come back as Bloomingdale's-only credit, not cash, gift cards or a statement credit. At 3 pts/$1 and 5,000 pts = $25, the effective rate is about 1.5%, rising to roughly 2% at 4 pts/$1. Rewards expire 180 days after they're issued, and on January 1 each year 85% of any remaining points are forfeited (members who join on or after October 1 are exempt the first year).

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: Loyallist points redeem only at Bloomingdale's or bloomingdales.com.

insurance.detail: Not confirmed on Citi's or Bloomingdale's public product pages for this card
Not confirmed on Citi's or Bloomingdale's public product pages for this card

protection_note: Despite running on the American Express network, this is a Citi-issued retail co-brand, not an Amex-issued card, so Amex's own purchase protection and extended warranty don't apply. No Guide to Benefits for this card was found. Treat it as a rewards-and-financing card with no insurance you can count on.
rental_note: No rental car coverage found for this card.

status_perks.name: Loyallist status tiers
status_perks.note: Loyallist (default), then Top of the List at $5,000 and Top of the List Unlocked at $15,000 in net purchases at Bloomingdale's in a calendar year. Unlocked earns 10 points per $1 at Bloomingdale's.

services.name: International transaction fee
services.detail: 3% on purchases and cash advances made in a foreign currency, per Bloomingdale's cardholder terms.

services.name: Special financing offers
services.detail: Deferred-interest/promotional financing periodically offered on qualifying Bloomingdale's purchases; check current terms before financing.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns rewards on their spend (into your account)
No dedicated insurance to share: this card doesn't carry a confirmed protection suite

additional_cards.note: Free to add, useful mainly for pooling a household's spend toward reaching a higher Loyallist tier faster.

timeline.text: Bloomingdale's/Citi issue two distinct card products: the closed-loop, store-only Bloomingdale's Credit Card (up to 10 pts/$1 at Bloomingdale's at top status, unusable elsewhere) and this open-loop Bloomingdale's American Express Card (3, 4 or 10 pts/$1 at Bloomingdale's depending on status, and 3 or 4 pts/$1 anywhere else Amex is accepted). Confirm which one you're comparing; they are not the same card.
